As a result, the length measurements of many rivers are only approximations (see also [coastline paradox](/wiki/Coastline_paradox "Coastline paradox")). In particular, there seems to exist disagreement as to whether the [Nile](/wiki/Nile "Nile")[[3]](#cite_note-britannica-nile-3) or the [Amazon](/wiki/Amazon_River "Amazon River")[[4]](#cite_note-britannica-amazon-4) is the world's longest river.
